disclosure_text: As an immigrant, woman, and person of color, my experiences were shaped by being marginalized, discriminated, and being outcasted.
micronarrative: The student reflecting on their own experiences of being discriminated stood out to me the most because I have moments where my experiences were drowned out and ignored as well. I had an experience with a racist lady at a hotel I used to work at. I then complained to our higher up but they just dismissed me and told me it probably was not a big deal. When I spoke to my supervisor, I had to sound a bit more professional in order to get my point across. I used a lot more formal language than what I was used to. I really felt like I had to fight really hard just to be taken seriously.
